summary: Firefox expands web platform support, including Permissions Policy (formerly Feature Policy), Declarative Web Push, the Sanitizer API for cleaning HTML, and CSS transform and perspective features. Page loading also gets smarter: speculation rules can trigger prefetches when people hover or press a link, while safeguards avoid fetching unsuitable pages. Other work improves APIs such as WebCrypto’s ML-KEM post-quantum key exchange and SpeechRecognition, and makes document, image, and resource lifetimes more reliable.
